The structure of Eu₂V₄C₄O₈ (reduced formula Eu(VCO₂)₂) is monoclinic, with space group P2₁/c (No. 14) and 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis identifies tetrahedral carbon centers coordinated by one C and three O neighbors, and octahedral vanadium centers coordinated by two C and four O neighbors, while Eu centers show nine geometric neighbors. The same analysis finds corner-sharing between C tetrahedra and V octahedra, and between V octahedra and Eu polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
